description: 🚀 Orbit of D. is a team driven by curiosity, creativity, and the spirit of exploration. Inspired by NASA's discoveries and One Piece's unbreakable will to explore the unknown, we're taking on NASA Space Apps 2026's “Abandoned but not Forgotten” challenge. Our goal is to bring the stories of NASA's forgotten equipment on the Moon and Mars to life through an interactive experience. We welcome passionate minds ready to explore beyond limits! 🌌
